browserScenarios: NEAR reuses signing observations, enforces exhausted quota, and reloads authority after refresh
NEAR prepare rejects a retired session without an owner-lane preflight and permits fresh unlock
NEAR registration shares overlapping observations, keeps queries fresh, and respects lock
a cross-tab lock prevents delayed restoration from recreating its credential
a fresh unlock survives a delayed restoration response from another tab
testSetupCorrections: Initial trace filename did not match the contract filter, then required an existing harness flow filename.
A reused local D1 state caused bootstrap CAS conflict; each accepted run used a fresh state directory.
The first lock probe waited on its own held response; release follows the observed lock transition.
A restart waited for the previous test service to stop.

independentSignatureVerification.verifier: Node.js crypto Ed25519 with independent NEP-413 Borsh encoding

limitations: Three samples per arm do not establish tail percentiles or a latency guarantee.
Sequential arms include provider scheduling and network variation.
Fresh wallets do not prove cold Workers. Worker cold starts were not controlled.
Invocation wall time can include background work and is not browser response time.
Nested spans overlap. Protocol spans include transport. Concurrent status durations must not be added.
Bound-root D1 counters cover a subset of database work. Total registration D1 calls remain unmeasured.
The SDK changes how many session reads occur. Each retained status request and signing prepare still checks current authorization.
Requested APAC placement does not prove physical colocation.

decision.reason: One or two duplicate status reads removed per registration, with one shared observation revision. Separate queries and signing prepare remain fresh. Five browser scenarios and nine independent signatures passed.
decision.performanceConclusion: No reliable full-flow latency improvement. Candidate median closely matches the restored SDK control, and SDK registration median is slower than that control.
